sine-cache.title: SinOsc phase-step cache
sine-cache.scope: Cache the exact integer phase step for unchanged initial/control-rate frequency. Audio-rate frequency retains sample-by-sample calculation.
sine-cache.qualification: Kernel equivalence is measured separately from whole-patch timings; no isolated universal SinOsc speed-up is claimed.

bandlimited-crossfade.title: Saw/Pulse crossfade fraction
bandlimited-crossfade.scope: Replace per-sample division by the power-of-two block size with exact reciprocal multiplication; preserve the bandlimited oscillator.
bandlimited-crossfade.qualification: The historical target timing isolates Saw in a two-Saw patch. Pulse shares the changed routine and has host coverage; no separate Pulse speed-up measurement is claimed. Blip was a regression case, not a changed loop.

dust-rng.title: Dust/Dust2 random-state locality
dust-rng.scope: Keep Taus88 state words local during each block, then commit once; preserve random word order.
dust-rng.qualification: Hardware evidence is the recorded Comb Cloud workload; not separate timing certification of every Dust2/rate combination.

decay-coefficients.title: Decay/Decay2 interpolation and coefficient reuse
decay-coefficients.scope: Use exact power-of-two block interpolation; independently cache Decay2 attack and decay coefficients. Retain compensated recurrences.
decay-coefficients.qualification: Hardware measurements cover recorded cloud patches, including the KR variant, not an isolated speed-up for every Decay layout.

filter-blocks.title: Eight filter block kernels
filter-blocks.scope: Resonz, Ringz, LPF, HPF, RLPF, RHPF, BPF and BRF bind inputs once per block and share each existing three-sample group coefficient calculation. Preserve constructor/control rules and arithmetic order.
filter-blocks.qualification: Latest XIAO filter fixture contains all eight types. Its aggregate saving is not the saving for each individual type or all rates.

lag-blocks.title: Lag/LagUD/LeakDC block kernels
lag-blocks.scope: Bind inputs once. Lag/LagUD cache unchanged smoothing-time coefficients independently; LeakDC uses the streamlined recurrence loop without that exponential time cache.
lag-blocks.qualification: Latest physical Lag fixture contains Lag and LagUD. LeakDC has historical broad-sweep hardware evidence and current host equivalence, but no dedicated current-build hardware timing in this fixture.

miverb-clamp.title: MiVerb ordered delay-write clamp
miverb-clamp.scope: Replace fminf/fmaxf calls after the finite-value guard with ordered comparisons; retain Q1.15 delay storage, saturation, quantisation and float processing.
miverb-clamp.qualification: Historical isolated-node and whole-patch timings are retained. Latest full-patch measurements include MiVerb but do not isolate a new clamp change.

rings-placement.title: MiRings1–6 memory placement and startup
rings-placement.scope: Keep selected hot Rings functions in instruction RAM and remove duplicate arena clearing at initialisation. Production retains the selected PSRAM arena; internal-arena experiments are not claimed enabled.
rings-placement.qualification: Placement/startup optimisation, not a changed resonator algorithm. Model and moving-control costs differ; historical overruns remain documented.

unary-blocks.title: UnaryOpUGen cache and block dispatch
unary-blocks.scope: All 33 supported selectors cache bitwise-unchanged scalar input/results, distinguishing signed zero. Twelve common audio selectors dispatch once per block; other audio selectors retain the original per-sample unary evaluator. No transcendental approximation.
unary-blocks.qualification: Latest hardware unary fixture measures repeated control-rate pitch math, not every selector/path. All selectors/rates have older broad-sweep hardware evidence; current all-selector differential checks are host-side.

inherited-envelope.title: EnvGen block renderer
inherited-envelope.scope: Existing FM1 fast_envelope path with bound inputs and segment processing. No newly isolated project-specific envelope algorithm speed-up claimed.
inherited-envelope.qualification: Historical hardware tests include envelope/rate fixtures; not a current per-UGen before/after performance claim.

inherited-pan.title: Pan2 cached block gains
inherited-pan.scope: Existing FM1 fast_pan path when position input is not audio rate; audio-rate position retains the general path.
inherited-pan.qualification: Path depends on input rate. Latest eight-Saw fixture also uses Pan2; no new isolated panner speed-up is claimed.

inherited-arithmetic.title: BinaryOpUGen/MulAdd/Sum3/Sum4 block arithmetic
inherited-arithmetic.scope: Existing FM1 bound-input arithmetic paths. Addition, subtraction, multiplication and floating division have direct common-rate loops; other binary selectors preserve the original evaluator and control-ramp semantics.
inherited-arithmetic.qualification: All 40 binary selectors have historical initial/control/audio hardware captures. This records an inherited block framework, not a dedicated new optimisation of every selector.

inherited-initial-cache.title: Existing initial-rate result caching
inherited-initial-cache.scope: SampleRate, SampleDur, ControlRate, ControlDur, BlockSize, RadiansPerSample, Rand, ExpRand, MaxLocalBufs, LocalBuf and SetBuf use initial-rate construction and per-voice cached result restoration. Their math/RNG/declaration handling does not run per audio sample. No new arithmetic optimisation or measured speed-up is claimed; removing construction or reseeding would change semantics.
inherited-initial-cache.qualification: Reviewed on 4 November 2026. Metadata/table setup and per-instance random generation remain necessary. Historical hardware coverage is separate from this computer-only review.

inherited-control-bank.title: Existing batched control and trigger banks
inherited-control-bank.scope: Control, TrigControl and LagControl have the existing one-pass output-bank renderer. LagControl computes its coefficient at initialisation and retains smoothing state; TrigControl clears triggers per control calculation. No new project speed-up is claimed.
inherited-control-bank.qualification: Reviewed on 4 November 2026. Preserve trigger clearing, per-channel smoothing and initial/control-rate behavior. These paths are already batched outside the generic sample switch.

inherited-bus-blocks.title: Existing bounded audio/control bus block loops
inherited-bus-blocks.scope: In.ar and Out.ar already validate the bus once per node and copy/deinterleave or accumulate complete channel blocks using stable pointers. In.kr is the project control-snapshot extension and reads once per control calculation. Required sample checks, interleaving and ordered mixing remain unchanged; no new performance change is claimed.
inherited-bus-blocks.qualification: Reviewed on 4 November 2026. The ledger records the existing batched paths, not an additional measured speed-up; general audio-bus expansion or dropping finite checks would change the supported contract.

inherited-freeverb.title: Existing generated FreeVerb block kernels
inherited-freeverb.scope: FreeVerb/FreeVerb2 already bind audio pointers and block-held mix/room/damping once, keep recurrence state local across the block and use generated unrolled comb/allpass loops. Their sample loop does not repeatedly decode graph inputs. No new algorithm or timing saving is claimed.
inherited-freeverb.qualification: Reviewed on 4 November 2026. A further redesign would need dependency/cache profiling and memory-layout analysis; the existing efficient block implementation is retained in this computer-only pass.

shared.title: Loader-planned signal-buffer reuse
shared.scope: Independent scalar storage and conservative audio-buffer lifetime reuse improve graph memory/capacity. This is not a per-UGen algorithm speed-up.

shared.title: Hot kernel/code and cache placement
shared.scope: Selected shared rendering, arithmetic, envelope, panning, filter, Lag, unary and delay routines use internal instruction RAM; lookup/cache configuration is profile-specific. Do not classify all consumers as individually rewritten.

experiments.title: MiVerb packed halfword delay access
experiments.scope: Host output/state checks passed, but measured XIAO rendering regressed. Production uses the ordered-clamp optimisation with existing byte-wise memory access.

candidates.title: Lag2/Lag3/OnePole/OneZero/LPZ1/HPZ1 block loops
candidates.scope: Bind inputs and choose the recurrence once per block. Lag2/3 cache the time coefficient in otherwise-unused freq state and retain multiply-then-scale interpolation order. Preserve OnePole constructor behavior, OneZero/LPZ1/HPZ1 initial history and coefficient-domain faults. Opt in with candidate_smooth=True; selected-layout hardware evidence is linked below.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.

candidates.hardware_metrics_scope: Each graph contains eight copies of the named smoothing UGen plus shared excitation/mixing.

candidates.title: Forty binary selectors: shared scalar path and complete audio specialisation coverage
candidates.scope: All 40 selectors use one shared scalar/scalar evaluation per block when applicable. The four inherited arithmetic audio loops plus 36 candidate loops move dispatch out of the sample loop. Changing-control ramps retain their pinned path. Held negative-zero inputs in discontinuous selectors deliberately fall back to preserve the -0 to +0 transient observed by downstream atan2. Exact composed regression and whole raw-scratch checks pass. Selected musical hardware timing is linked below.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.

candidates.hardware_metrics_scope: These are musical regressions exercising selectors 0, 2 and 4, not isolated measurements of all 40 selectors.

candidates.title: WhiteNoise/PinkNoise/LFNoise0–2 block rendering
candidates.scope: Keep the same Taus88 state local throughout each node and commit before its successor. Hoist type dispatch and frequency decoding. LFNoise reuses exact segment length within each block; PinkNoise uses guarded ctz with the original zero-word mapping. Shared-sequence, interleaved RandSeed, constructor/history and 200,000 private index probes pass. Desktop bank timings and offline Xtensa object cost are recorded; opt in with candidate_noise=True.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.

candidates.title: Block-bound input references across ten renderer entry points
candidates.scope: Hoist graph-reference decoding and input-rate lookup into per-call local pointers, without changing sample indices, parameters, equations or state. Seventy-two types share the touched renderers; not all benefit. All timing rows below are retained, including native regressions. Binding-only and combined variants each pass 2,176 graphs with complete state and arena identity. Target code/stack cost is recorded; selected-layout target timing, including regressions, is linked below. Opt in with candidate_binding=True.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.

candidates.hardware_metrics_scope: Narrowed to delay_render and render_miverb; these graphs exercise modulated delay time or reverb parameters.

candidates.title: Converters, short delays, selectors and seed control
candidates.scope: Dedicated A2K/K2A/DC, Delay1/2, Select, Clip, DegreeToKey and RandSeed loops retain exact constructor history, legal initial-rate result caching, interpolation order, sign behavior, trigger/seed ordering and faults. A held Select selector resolves the chosen source once per block; a held DegreeToKey input computes its key once. No new persistent fields. Opt in with candidate_routing=True.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.

candidates.title: Fourteen exact chaos cycle-period caches
candidates.scope: Cache the unchanged held frequency period and, for interpolating variants, the original reciprocal slope. A compile-time check puts freq/b1/b2 cache fields beyond the complete overlaid chaos_state. No recurrence, interpolation, reset or nonlinear math changes. Code shrinks in the measured Xtensa object; native effects vary by model. All four-rate dynamic frequency probes and full state comparisons pass. The initially rejected timing harness and its corrected cache normalization are retained separately. Opt in with candidate_chaos=True.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.

candidates.title: Oscillator, ramp, partial-bank and Gendy candidates
candidates.scope: Dedicated LFSaw/LFTri/LFPulse and Klang/Klank loops retain compensated phase, partial order and constructor resets. Line caches only invariant compensated span terms; XLine caches its held ratio, retaining per-sample pow and precise timing. Formant caches integer increments/width. Gendy1–3 cache independent distribution constants. SinOscFB caches exact phase steps and bit-keyed feedback targets; Blip caches effective crossfade frequency and harmonic scales, including the descending-frequency transition. Only documented otherwise-unused cache fields are normalized in comparisons. Native regressions and negligible gains are retained; timings vary between runs and fixtures, so no universal speed claim is made. Opt in with candidate_core=True. BPeakEQ/BLowShelf/BHiShelf and Formlet calculate each unchanged three-sample coefficient group once, retaining the exact division and final one-sample group. Amplitude caches attack/release coefficients independently and preserves audio-input/control-output stepping.

hardware_coverage.scope: Selected-layout 50-case replay plus fixed-seed XIAO profiling where applicable; normal/instrumented state checks and cross-image audio/RNG equality. Hardware timings are scoped whole-graph results, not full-rate/type qualification or a production promotion.
